question: How does the self stand surrounded by fire on one foot?
premises: vahni nāveṣṭita means surrounded by fire
eka pādena saṃsthitam means standing on one foot
inference: The self stands surrounded by fire on one foot.
uncertainties: exact case relation of ātmānam to saṃsthitam
plain_english: The self, surrounded by fire, stands on one foot.
